title: Sources
description: Pages the scanner reads. Only enabled sources are scanned.

id.description: Unique short id, lowercase with dashes.

category.description: Free label, e.g. investor, challenge, government.

update_frequency.description: How often it changes, e.g. weekly, monthly, yearly.

status.description: Result of the last freshness check: recommended = dated and fresh; unverified = no checkable date; stale = older than 12 months; manual = cannot be read automatically.

last_verified.description: Date of the last freshness check.

last_seen_update.description: Newest publication date seen on the page (never a future event date).

date_source.description: Where on the page that date was found.
